title: Citizen of the Week
text: Welcome to Citizen of the Week, where ordinary people achieve extraordinary levels of not getting involved. Nominations are collected automatically.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: This week's finalist watched his neighbor's house collapse, checked the evacuation app, and reported an excellent user experience.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: Our next nominee found an unfamiliar card in the street and handed it to Security without reading a single word. A beautiful example of functional literacy.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: One resident corrected her own eyewitness account before officials asked. <break time="0.45s" /> She has been promoted to witness for the prosecution.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: And a special commendation for the citizen who noticed an unmarked van, smiled politely, and made room at the curb.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: The winner of Citizen of the Week has agreed to donate the prize money to the department that selected them. That's what we call community.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: Honorable mention goes to a resident who reported his own suspicious silence. Investigators described the conversation as highly productive.

title: Citizen of the Week
text: Remember, anyone can become Citizen of the Week. Some people are entered more than once, under different names.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: Welcome to Who Wants to Be Compliant? Four choices, one correct answer, and a sponsor who knows which one.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: Question one! Who owns the information collected by your household appliances? A: you. B: the manufacturer. C: a trusted partner. The correct answer is: thank you for participating.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: Quick-fire round! Is compulsory participation voluntary? Yes, yes with enthusiasm, or yes after reviewing the terms? <break time="0.45s" /> All three advance to the next round.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: A viewer asks whether the quiz can be skipped. Congratulations! That was our trick question. The viewer has already qualified.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: What is the safest response to an unexplained government vehicle? Keep walking, stop walking, or report the walking? Our judges accept any response submitted in advance.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: Tonight's jackpot is a lifetime exemption from unnecessary questions. Winners receive a certificate, which is itself a necessary question.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: Our contestant used the phone-a-friend lifeline. The friend's phone answered on behalf of both parties. A brilliant team effort.

title: Who Wants to Be Compliant?
text: Another flawless game! Remember, on Who Wants to Be Compliant, you can't lose. The losses are processed by another department.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: It's election night on Democracy Deluxe! Stay for the count, the charts, and the moving tribute to a winner we can already confirm.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: The public has narrowed the field to a remarkable range of approved opinions, from strongly recommended to very strongly recommended.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: Our interactive voting line is open! Press one to support the outcome. Press two to support the process. All other keys are comments.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: This evening's exit poll has achieved a hundred percent accuracy. It was conducted entirely inside the ballot-printing facility.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: We asked citizens what mattered most: freedom, security, or convenient billing. Our sponsor was deeply moved by their answers and selected security.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: The undecided voters have finally decided. They will be moved to a separate statistical category with no effect on the result.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: The opposition has made an important contribution to democracy by appearing in the official photograph. Their objections were cropped for clarity.

title: Democracy Deluxe!
text: Democracy Deluxe will return after a brief emergency. Emergency extensions are determined by popular demand from the board.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: This is The Consensus Challenge, the only quiz where the experts agree before we've finished asking the question.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: Round one! Can you tell the peer-reviewed study from the shareholder presentation? Hint: the shareholder presentation has fewer footnotes and a better catering budget.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: Follow the science! Our contestants are following it down the hallway, past the ethics office, and into a private investor briefing.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: Tonight's hypothesis is officially evidence-based. The evidence will be delivered as soon as procurement completes its internal review.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: A caller has requested the raw data. Wonderful curiosity! Our help desk has sent them a beautifully illustrated summary of why they don't need it.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: In a stunning display of independence, all five panelists arrived at the same conclusion. The sixth panelist arrived at the airport and was turned away.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: Our audience has correctly identified the expert by his credentials, the approved backdrop, and the tiny logo on the coffee mug.

title: The Consensus Challenge
text: That's all for The Consensus Challenge. Stay tuned for tomorrow's new findings, which will have been true all along.

title: EULA Bingo
text: EULA Bingo is back! Fill an entire card with permissions you didn't know you granted, and win one additional permission.

title: EULA Bingo
text: Today's first square: perpetual retention. Your grandmother had the family albums. Your toaster has the family's movement history.

title: EULA Bingo
text: Eyes down for our bonus square: legitimate interest! Nobody knows whose interest, but the lawyers look absolutely thrilled.

title: EULA Bingo
text: A player selected Decline All. That's a rare one! The system recorded her preference and opened the full terms in a new window.

title: EULA Bingo
text: Our next number is thirty-seven: the number of third parties who became first parties while you were reading the consent screen.

title: EULA Bingo
text: We've reached the blackout round! Every box is ticked, every option is grey, and the prize is continued access to your own front door.

title: EULA Bingo
text: The winner receives a handwritten copy of their privacy agreement. For security, the handwriting will be replaced with a QR code.

title: EULA Bingo
text: Thanks for playing EULA Bingo. Your attendance has already been shared with our affiliates, including those who don't exist yet.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: Welcome to Neighborhood Watch-Along! The camera never blinks, so we don't have to worry about missing your little moments.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: Our live mystery tonight: who entered the empty street after curfew? Was it a trespasser, an authorized patrol, or the person who wrote the curfew?

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: Look closely at this harmless shadow near the doorway. If it belongs to you, congratulations: you've identified yourself for our prize department.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: A resident's refrigerator detected a three-second pause before breakfast. The neighborhood voted to classify it as suspicious contemplation.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: We've brought back audience voting! Tap the face you recognize. The faces will be retained after the program ends.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: That unmarked vehicle is our mystery guest. We won't reveal the driver, because the driver knows who you are.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: Our caller says there are no cameras on her street. <break time="0.45s" /> That's exactly what the camera report says as well.

title: Neighborhood Watch-Along
text: Neighborhood Watch-Along is brought to you by Smart Dust. We're everywhere in the community, especially between the community.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: Welcome to The Founder Knows Best, where democracy gets a performance review and the chief executive takes the throne without leaving his ergonomic chair.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: Tonight's design challenge: build a nation with the customer service of a cable company and the accountability of a private island.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: Our founder explains that voting is an outdated interface. Now every citizen gets a login, a dashboard, and the opportunity to renew their contract.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: The shareholder council has approved freedom of movement for all premium residents. Standard users may enjoy freedom of scrolling.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: Our meritocracy is open to everyone. The qualifying round takes place before birth, and winners inherit their entry fees.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: A question from the audience: who watches the sovereign? Excellent question! The sovereign's venture capital partners are watching very closely.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: This week's constitutional amendment reduces the number of constitutional amendments requiring approval. It's what we call frictionless government.

title: The Founder Knows Best
text: You've been watching The Founder Knows Best. Next week: why your town hall is now a co-working space with armed receptionists.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: Welcome to The Price Is Permitted! Guess the price of everyday necessities before your wallet decides whether you deserve them.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: First prize: a loaf of bread. Retail value, three credits. Purchase eligibility, twenty-seven variables. Our contestant is missing one approved smile.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: We've got a special on freedom! It's available in three easy installments and cannot be transferred, inherited, or spent outside your designated district.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: Spin the wheel! Food, fuel, or personal travel? <break time="0.45s" /> The wheel has landed on risk assessment. What a popular category.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: A contestant tried to tip the cashier in cash. The studio lights went red, and the cashier received a valuable training opportunity.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: The bonus round is Reverse Shopping: the less you buy, the more we learn about what prevented you.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: Tonight's grand prize is debt forgiveness! The debt remains, but our app will stop calling it a debt until Thursday.

title: The Price Is Permitted
text: Thank you for playing The Price Is Permitted. All winnings expire if the terms of your personality change.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Welcome to Memory Makeover! We take the troubling news you remember and give it the finish it deserves.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Our first before-and-after features a collapsed apartment block. Before: rubble. After: a sustainable open-plan view. The tenants are still in post-production.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Do you remember the blackout? Of course you do! Our new archive has restored the electricity to every official photograph.

title: Memory Makeover
text: This caller insists her street used to have a library. Good news: the building remains in our files as a successful digital learning space.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Today's makeover challenge is a missing person. We can't bring the person back, but we can give the absence a more inclusive name.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Our archivist found two contradictory eyewitness accounts. For a seamless result, we selected the one already printed on the banner.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Everyone loves the new timeline! It contains twelve fewer emergencies and an unexpectedly large number of product launches.

title: Memory Makeover
text: Memory Makeover is sponsored by YesterdayPlus. Because the future shouldn't have to apologize for the past.

title: The Happiness Index
text: You're watching The Happiness Index, where we measure your joy so you can stop pretending to feel it yourself.

title: The Happiness Index
text: Today's most improved citizen raised their happiness score by smiling at a security checkpoint. Facial discomfort has been logged as enthusiasm.

title: The Happiness Index
text: Here's our wellness tip: if the world outside is upsetting, turn off the window and consult the official mood forecast.

title: The Happiness Index
text: Let's check the leaderboard! First place is held by an anonymous account with excellent benefits and no documented physical body.

title: The Happiness Index
text: The audience has reported a drop in morale. Our researchers fixed the questionnaire. Morale is up forty percent.

title: The Happiness Index
text: Your employer has purchased a happiness subscription for you. Cancellation requires a written statement that you are unhappy, which lowers your score.

title: The Happiness Index
text: Our weekly winner receives a full weekend of rest, subject to productivity monitoring and weekday availability.

title: The Happiness Index
text: That's The Happiness Index. Remember, your smile is yours. The measurements belong to us.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: It's time for Public Enemy Makeover, the show that turns every unexplained stranger into the face of a national conversation.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: Our mystery contestant has collected another unauthorized card. Is that a hobby, a political movement, or a merchandising opportunity? Stay tuned.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: A building has disappeared, and the authorities have a new suspect. The before picture is classified. The after picture is available on a commemorative mug.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: Tonight's challenge: identify the public enemy using only a coat, a blurry silhouette, and an increasingly confident voice-over.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: Our studio audience has voted the fugitive a national disgrace. The advertising department has voted them an excellent brand partner.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: Security has issued a fresh warning: do not approach the suspect. Fans are advised that autographs are prohibited within the cordon.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: An exciting twist! Yesterday's terrorist is today's urban-renewal pioneer. The category changed while our commercial was playing.

title: Public Enemy Makeover
text: Don't miss Public Enemy Makeover. The search continues, even when the story says the suspect has already been found.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: Welcome to The Great Normalize-Off! Our panel has sixty seconds to turn a public disaster into an award-winning lifestyle announcement.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: Round one! A bridge is gone. The planning department calls it a pedestrian-friendly gap. The sponsor calls it an invitation to upgrade your commute.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: The winning entry for a missing neighborhood is: temporary reduction in urban density. Bonus points for the word temporary.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: A factory exploded near the town square. The publicist calls it a new approach to open-air manufacturing. The jury is delighted by the transparency.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: Now for our speed round: sirens become sound baths; barricades become wellness borders; missing witnesses become data minimization.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: Tonight's final challenge: explain why the cameras went dark. Our contestant says privacy. Security says scheduled maintenance. Both earn a prize.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: The audience says it saw the incident. The judges say it saw an opportunity. Only the judges' answer fits on the billboard.

title: The Great Normalize-Off
text: Thank you for watching The Great Normalize-Off. Nothing happened, and the winners will be recognized at the site of the event.

title: Studio Links
text: And after this brief commercial break: a democracy special brought to you by the people who wrote the ballot.

title: Studio Links
text: Coming up on Brave New World News: one missing district, three successful narratives, and absolutely no outstanding questions.

title: Studio Links
text: Vote now for tonight's most convincing explanation! Your vote may be retained for training and is not required to influence the outcome.

title: Studio Links
text: Our studio poll is open. We can assure you that your answer will remain anonymous until it becomes useful.

title: Studio Links
text: A round of applause for our studio audience of everyday citizens, whose attendance was selected by an independent algorithm.

title: Studio Links
text: The opinions expressed by our audience are not necessarily the opinions they had before entering the building.

title: Studio Links
text: Thank you for that spontaneous applause. The applause signs have now been switched off. Please continue.

title: Studio Links
text: The Brave New World News truth hotline is open twenty-four hours a day. Calls will be answered by whatever you need to hear.

title: Studio Links
text: It's the final round! The contestant is free to choose the answer, provided the answer has already been cleared.

title: Studio Links
text: We interrupt this program with a correction to the announcement we haven't made yet.

title: Studio Links
text: Consume. Believe. Obey. <break time="0.45s" /> And now, back to the game.

title: Studio Links
text: This is Brave New World News. The audience has been wonderful. Their profiles will be reviewed overnight.
